nuggets.text: Kenny Minchey threw for 301 yards and four TDs with no picks in his first start, a combo no Kentucky QB had in a debut.
Kenny Minchey's four touchdown passes went to four different Wildcats, including two tight ends and two true freshmen.
Will Stein's Wildcats scored 45 in his debut, the most by a Kentucky coach in his first game since 1938.
Will Stein grew up in Louisville and walked on as a quarterback at Louisville before becoming Kentucky's head coach.
Will Stein kept coaching Oregon's offense through the 2025 College Football Playoff after Kentucky hired him.
Will Stein has asked fans to make Saturday 'the loudest game in the history of Kentucky.'
The Wildcats' 1997 upset of Alabama ended on Tim Couch's 26-yard overtime TD pass to Craig Yeast, 40-34.
The Wildcats' live mascot, a bobcat named Blue, rarely attends games because of the animal's shy nature.
The Wildcats got their name in 1909, when a commandant said the team 'fought like Wildcats' in a win over Illinois.
Kenny Minchey, a Notre Dame transfer, first committed to Nebraska before flipping to Kentucky.
